From the blog

"While a preorder is running, we will post daily updates on week days."

We got 9, of 23 and one of those was "Hey, it's over" which would extend the number of updates to 24.

Kaargra Warfang is a noble Leige, valiantly seeking the bravest and most noble knights of the Multiverse to join her at her court.  She searches with heavy heart for those brave and virtuous enough to win the hearts of the people and survive the tests she lays before them.
